g.title: Takes the 16 kHz mono audio from decode. A SpeechDetector scores each 32 ms window. EnergyDetector is the default and Silero via ONNX Runtime is a cargo feature. A state machine ends a clip after 500 ms of quiet, keeps 3 to 30 s, and cuts long runs at their deepest dip.
score returns WADA-SNR, RMS dBFS, clip ratio and spectral flatness, with no ML model. FilterPolicy::evaluate returns the first failing RejectReason, or none if the clip is kept.

Writes each kept clip as a .wav and .json pair in shard-*.tar, plus manifest.jsonl and stats.json, into the output directory. Shards are built in a staging directory and renamed into place when complete. Only kept clips are stored.
Rejected clips aren't written. Their reasons are counted in the run totals and shown per clip by inspect and the live service.
